description: Defines Pydantic data models for the NoteMaster API, specifying request and response schemas for notes including creation, update, output, and list representations.

classes.name: NoteBase
classes.description: Base model for creating or updating notes with common fields such as title, content, tags, and pinned status.

classes.name: NoteCreate
classes.description: Payload model for creating a new note, inheriting from NoteBase.

classes.name: NoteUpdate
classes.description: Model for updating existing notes with all fields optional.

classes.name: NoteOut
classes.description: Representation of a note sent in responses, including metadata like id, timestamps, and fields.

classes.name: NoteListOut
classes.description: Container model for a list of notes with total count.
